## Preamble

This analysis builds on the prior GO Enrichment by examining KEGG terms instead, acquiring some more specific gene pathway information.

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

## 2. Load KEGG Terms

```{r}
# Load genes from KEGG for Mesocricetus auratus
maua_raw <- read_tsv("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/maua",
                     col_names = c("kegg_id", "type", "location", "desc"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

# Get KEGG ID 
kegg_map <- maua_raw %>%
  mutate(entrez_id = str_remove(kegg_id, "^maua:"),
         sym_part  = if_else(str_detect(desc, ";"),
                             str_extract(desc, "^[^;]+"),
                             paste0("LOC", entrez_id))) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(sym_part, delim = ", ") %>%
  mutate(gene_id = str_trim(sym_part)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, entrez_id) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## 3. Load Data & Pull Significant KEGG Terms

```{r}
# Load data + bind entrez IDs
diff_expressed_genes <- read_tsv("../data/DESeq2/sam_all_diff_expressed.tsv") %>%
  left_join(kegg_map, by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(entrez_id = if_else(is.na(entrez_id) & str_detect(gene_id, "^LOC[0-9]+$"),
                             str_remove(gene_id, "^LOC"),
                             entrez_id)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(entrez_id))


# Pull up- and down-regulated gene entrez IDs
upreg_entrez <- diff_expressed_genes %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange >= 1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(entrez_id)

downreg_entrez <- diff_expressed_genes %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(entrez_id)


# Conduct KEGG enrichment
kegg_upreg <- enrichKEGG(gene = upreg_entrez,
                         organism = "maua",
                         keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
                         pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                         qvalueCutoff = 0.2)

kegg_downreg <- enrichKEGG(gene = downreg_entrez,
                           organism = "maua",
                           keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
                           pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                           qvalueCutoff = 0.2)


# Save KEGG enrichment data
write_tsv(as.data.frame(kegg_upreg),
          "../data/KEGG_enrichment/kegg_upreg.tsv")
write_tsv(as.data.frame(kegg_downreg),
          "../data/KEGG_enrichment/kegg_downreg")
```

## 4. Visualize Significant Up-regulated KEGG Terms

```{r}
# Get up-regulated KEGG Term data frame
kegg_upreg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_upreg) %>%
  filter(category != "Human Diseases") %>%
  head(15) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "UP",
         GeneRatio_num = Count/DESize,
         Label = str_wrap(Description, 45))

# Plot
kegg_upreg_plot <- kegg_upreg_df %>%
  mutate(Label = fct_reorder(Label, GeneRatio_num)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Label, color = p.adjust, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.02) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8), breaks = c(12, 16, 20)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       y = "KEGG Term",
       color = "p-value",
       size  = "Gene Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96"),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "black", size = 9.5))

kegg_upreg_plot

ggsave("../visualizations/KEGG_enrichment/kegg_upreg_lolipop.png",
       plot = kegg_upreg_plot, width = 8, height = 8)
```

## 5. Visualize Significant Down-regulated KEGG Terms

```{r}
# Get down-regulated KEGG Term data frame
kegg_downreg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_downreg) %>%
  filter(category != "Human Diseases") %>%
  head(15) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "DOWN",
         GeneRatio_num = Count/DESize,
         Label = str_wrap(Description, 45))

# Plot
kegg_downreg_plot <- kegg_downreg_df %>%
  mutate(Label = fct_reorder(Label, GeneRatio_num)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Label, color = p.adjust, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.05) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8), breaks = c(12, 16, 20)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       y = "KEGG Term",
       color = "p-value",
       size  = "Gene Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96"),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "black", size = 9.5))

kegg_downreg_plot

ggsave("../visualizations/KEGG_enrichment/kegg_downreg_lolipop.png",
       plot = kegg_downreg_plot, width = 8, height = 8)
```

## 6. Visualize Both Sets of Significant KEGG Terms Together

```{r}
# Join up- and down-regulated KEGG Terms
kegg_joined_df <- bind_rows(kegg_downreg_df, kegg_upreg_df) %>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("DOWN", "UP")),
         Label = fct_reorder(Label, GeneRatio_num, .fun = max))

# Plot
kegg_joined_plot <- kegg_joined_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Label, color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  facet_grid(. ~ Direction) +
  labs(x = "Gene Ratio",
       y = "KEGG Term",
       color = "p-value",
       size  = "Gene Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"))

kegg_joined_plot

ggsave("../visualizations/KEGG_enrichment/kegg_joined_lolipop.png",
       plot = kegg_joined_plot, width = 10.5, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
```
